Governing documents: NSHE Board of Regents Handbook Title 4 Chapter 3 (Rev. 272, 12/16), which governs university academic faculty as professional staff (s.2.1.a), sets sick leave (s.19), FMLA (s.19.6, s.21), additional unpaid parental leave (s.19.6), annual leave (s.20), leave without salary (s.14) and reduced appointments (s.42). The UNLV Flexibility of Pre-Tenure Probationary Period Policy (rev. Sept 2013) governs tenure extensions. The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply: a governing document for faculty leave covering tenure-stream faculty is saved, so missing is false.

2018_01 (signed 3/11/2009, 'REVISION DATE: N/A', captured 2016) is titled a summary. Its NSHE part summarises the Handbook using the pre-2016 section numbers (its s.14.3/14.4/14.6/15/16 match the content of Rev. 272 s.19.3/19.4/19.6/20/21); the Handbook decides those provisions. Its 'UNLV Parental Leave Practices' section states practices found in no other saved document (reassignment to non-classroom duties for the rest of the term, c8; the pregnancy safety accommodation, c11; FMLA part-time leave, c12; graduate assistants, c14). I read that section as UNLV's governing statement (signed policy format; the HR page links the document as 'Parental Leave Policy') and did not apply summary_only. Each such component is flagged ambiguous. If the document is ruled a summary, c8, c11, c12 and c14 take summary_only, and the record has no counted relief.

Document dates: Handbook pages all Rev. 272 (12/16), captured 2017-08-29; Flexibility policy revised September 2013, captured 2016-08-25; summary 2009 with no revision, captured 2016-08-24; bylaws Rev. (05/12), captured 2017-05-08; HR FMLA page captured 2017-09-07. All are accepted as in force on the reference date 2018-03-12 (none shows a later effective date).

2018_04_unlv_bylaws holds no parental, leave or tenure-extension provision (sick leave appears only as restoration after layoff, s.19.6.4, 19.9, 19.13.2); it defines tenured and tenure-track academic faculty (Ch. I s.4.1.1) and lists Liberal Arts, Sciences and Engineering among the units, confirming main-campus coverage of NSHE and UNLV-wide provisions.

Statements recorded but not coded as components: summary practice 3a, 'The University does not impose a delay in consideration for promotion or tenure for academic faculty who use parental leave up to 12 weeks' in duration' (no benefit, a statement that no delay is imposed); practice 3c, approval of additional unpaid leave may be conditioned on an agreement about the tenure timetable (noted on c4); practice 4, post-doctoral scholars, visiting faculty and faculty-in-residence have the same parental-leave rights subject to FMLA eligibility; the University continues paying health benefits during unpaid FMLA leave (Handbook s.19.6; summary 1c); FMLA military caregiver (26 weeks) and qualifying exigency leave (HR page).

U8 paths: unpaid sick leave up to three months for employees with under 12 consecutive months of employment (Handbook s.19.8) is the path for a shorter service band and is recorded in c5's duration_note, not as a component. The 30 working days of first-year sick leave (s.19.1) likewise belong to the first year; the two-year member draws on an accrued balance (c2).

Birth parent chain: relief from classroom teaching for the semester (c8) containing FMLA leave of 12 workweeks (c1, with own sick leave c2 used within it) -> additional unpaid parental leave up to one year (c4, consecutive_after c1); separately, if a physician certifies inability to return after sick and annual balances, discretionary extended salaried sick leave of 3 months (c5 consecutive_after c2, with its pay c6 within c5).

Non-birth parent chain: relief from classroom teaching for the semester (c8) containing FMLA leave of 12 workweeks (c1, own sick leave c2 within it) -> additional unpaid parental leave up to one year (c4, consecutive_after c1).
